x: ( 1 Elliott 3.39.66 2 Coe 3.39.79 10 S Paton 3.42.98.) Pole Vault- Phil Lovell seemed stuck on 4.60 upto this stage of the season and that was again the height he achieved here in 7th place.

John qualified for the final by winning his heat in a fast but comfortable 3.36.85 and based on that run and the efforts of the other qualifiers, had much more than an outside chance of a medal despite the presence of Cram and Coe.

The IAAF should set a high qualification standard and then allow all athletes from affiliated nations who reach that standard during the 12 months before the games to take their places at the championships. No more "Coe must go" type problems. No arguments as to whether favouritism exists among selectors.
